Hydrogen - Stamp Decreaser: Every day you log in, the resource cost to upgrade a stamp's max lv decreases by 40% up to a max of 90%. This reduction resets back to 0% when upgrading any stamp max lv.(1 per level)
Helium - Talent Power Stacker: All talents that give more bonus per 'Power of 10 resources you own' will count +8 more powers of 10 than you actually own when giving the bonus.(1 per level)

Lithium - Bubble Insta Expander: No Bubble Left Behind bonus now has a 15% chance to level up the lowest bubble out of ALL bubbles, not just the first 15 of each colour. Also, +40% chance to give +1 additional Lv.(1 per level)
Beryllium - Post Office Penner: Every day, 1 silver pen from your Post Office will instantly convert into 1 PO Box for all characters. This conversion happens 280 times per day.(7 per level)

Boron - Particle Upgrader: When a bubble has a cost of 100M or more to upgrade, you can instead spend particles. However, you can only do this 80 times a day, after which the cost will return to resources.(2 per level)

Carbon - Wizard Maximizer: All wizard towers in construction get +60 max levels. Also, all wizards get a +2% damage bonus for each wizard tower level above 50 in construction. Total bonus: 1.600% wizard dmg.(2 per level)
Nitrogen - Construction Trimmer: Gold trimmed construction slots give +300% more build rate than before. Also, you now have 1 additional trimmed slot.(15 per level)
Oxygen - Library Booker: Increases the Checkout Refresh Speed of the Talent Library by +40%. Also, the Minimum Talent LV is increased by +(2 per level)
Fluoride - Void Plate Chef: Multiplies your cooking speed by +30% for every meal at Lv 30+. In other words, every plate with a studded black void plate. Total bonus: >% cooking speed(1 per level)
Neon - Damage N' Cheapener: Increases your total damage by +30%. Also, reduces the cost of all atom upgrades by 30% too.(1 per level)
Sodium - Snail Kryptonite: When you fail a snail upgrade, it's LV gets reset to the nearest 5 (Up to Lv 40) instead of back to 0, like failing at Lv 7 will reset to Lv 5.(5 per level)

Magnesium - Trap Compounder: Every day, critters gained from traps increases by +5%. This bonus is capped at 60 days, and resets back to +0% when a new trap is placed.3/100 days since last retrap(1 per level)
Aluminium - Stamp Supercharger: Stamp Doublers give an extra +0% MORE bonus than the normal +100% they give!(1 per level)
Silicon - Minehead Currency Printer: Boosts your Minehead Currency gain by +0%! This is a new multiplier, so it's always relevant!(1 per level)
Phosphorus - Sushi Bucks Generator: Boosts your Sushi Station Bucks gain by +0%! This is a new multiplier, so it's always relevant!(1 per level)
Sulfur - Jelly Bloodcell Juicer: Boosts your Jelly Operator Bloodcell gain by +0%! Can you guess whether this is a new multiplier? I'll give you a hint, it's always relevant...(1 per level)
Chlorine - Lumi Gainer: Boosts your hourly Lumi Gain over at the Luminous Menagerie by +0%! This is NOT a new multiplier, you'll have to live with an additive atom bonus, womp womp.(2 per level)
